source_relationship: Retained baseline. The connection module adds explicitly negotiated Wi-Fi wake capability admission; Security 2 remains byte-identical. Bundled file hashes identify this adaptation. The new removal client uses the existing authenticated forget/check/commit contract and retains its last-network and durable-save gates. An explicit null app-side session timeout disables only that optional timer; the firmware BLE window and transport/authentication limits remain enforced.
